verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents Reserved Instances: you pre-pay for GPU time to get discounts of up to 50%, and you can convert any on-demand instance to a reserved one at any time at a lower hourly rate. This directly delivers a committed-use discount for sustained capacity. Missing for 10: documented commitment terms or durations and refund/cancellation rules, explicit evidence that a reservation guarantees capacity on a host-run marketplace, CLI/API support for creating reservations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
